## About
Papa Bear Roofing is family owned and operated. Tim Chittim and his crew work on residential and commercial roofs across Cedar Park, Leander and the North Austin area, from a simple ventilation repair to a full roof replacement.
Whether it's asphalt shingles, architectural shingles, a metal roof or a commercial TPO roof, we can do it all. If a storm, wind or hail has done damage, we'll come take a look for free and help you work with your insurance company.
Our neighbors have given us a 5 star rating from 211 Google reviews.

## Services
- Roof Repair: Affordable repairs for residential and commercial roofs.
- Roof Replacement: Full roof replacement for homes, plus commercial TPO roofs.
- Single-Ply TPO Roofing (Thermoplastic Polyolefin): Single-ply TPO systems for commercial roofs.
- Fluid Applied Metal Roof Coatings: Coatings applied to metal roofs.
- Free Inspections: Free inspections for storm, wind and hail damage.
- Insurance Claims: Help filing a roofing insurance claim with your insurance company.
- Asphalt Shingles and Architectural Shingles: Repair and replacement for shingle roofs and metal roofs.
- Roof Ventilation Repair & Replacement: From a simple ventilation repair to a full replacement.

## FAQ
Q: Do you charge for a roof inspection?
A: No. Call us for a free inspection, especially after storm, wind or hail damage.

Q: Can you help with my insurance claim?
A: Yes. We'll help you file a roofing insurance claim with your insurance company.

Q: What areas do you serve?
A: Cedar Park, Leander and the surrounding North Austin areas, including Travis, Williamson, Hays, Burnet and Bell counties, among others.

Q: When can I call?
A: Our listed hours are open 24 hours, every day of the week.
